identificationModule.briefTitle: Defibrotide in Sickle Cell Disease-Related Acute Chest Syndrome
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Study to Determine the Safety of Defibrotide in Sickle Cell Disease-Related Acute Chest Syndrome

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study evaluates the safety of defibrotide in subjects with sickle cell disease (SCD)-associated acute chest syndrome (ACS).

interventions.name: Defibrotide
interventions.description: Defibrotide 6.25 mg/kg IV q6h up to 7 days

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of patients with grade III/IV allergic reaction to defibrotide
primaryOutcomes.description: All patients will be monitored for allergic reaction probably or definitely related to defibrotide administration.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of patients with grade III/IV hemorrhage
primaryOutcomes.description: All patients will be monitored for hemorrhage probably or definitely related to defibrotide.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of patients with improvement in clinical signs of Acute Chest Syndrome
secondaryOutcomes.description: Patients will have pre and post treatment assessments with imaging and blood tests to monitor clinical signs of ACS
